ja: ケロロ軍曹のメカVer.もこれで勢揃い！“ドロロロボ”発進！
切り離しただけで手足が可動する約45mmのドロロ兵長が付属。
ドロロは専用ソーサーに搭乗、ソーサーはそのままロボ本体と合体！
en: Sergeant Keroro's mecha version is now available! “Dororo Robo” takes off!
Approximately 45mm Dororo Corporal whose limbs can be moved just by separating them is included.
Dororo rides on a special saucer, and the saucer is combined with the robot itself!
